title: From Scores to Safe Sets: Exact Safety--Constrained Decoding for Medication Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent generative medication recommendation systems ultimately produce sets of drugs, but drug--drug interaction (DDI) constraints depend on the set as a whole. A natural post-hoc approach is to first predict medications and then locally repair interacting pairs by removing one drug at a time. We ask whether this local repair step itself introduces avoidable error. Using fixed medication scores from FLAME's frozen classifier on MIMIC-III, we compare increasingly strong local repair strategies with an exact global decoder while holding the scores, output size, and DDI constraint fixed. The global decoder jointly selects the highest-scoring feasible medication set using mixed-integer linear programming. Across validation and test splits, global decoding consistently achieves higher Jaccard similarity than greedy repair, degree-aware repair, and degree-aware repair strengthened with exhaustive 1-swap local search. translated_title: 从分数到安全集合：药物推荐中精确的安全约束解码
translated_abstract: 最近的生成式药物推荐系统最终输出的是一组药物，但药物-药物相互作用（DDI）约束依赖于整个药物集合。一种自然的事后处理方法是先预测药物，然后通过每次移除一种药物来局部修复存在相互作用的药物对。我们探究这一局部修复步骤本身是否会引入可避免的错误。在固定FLAME冻结分类器在MIMIC-III上产生的药物分数的情况下，我们在保持分数、输出大小和DDI约束不变的前提下，将逐渐增强的局部修复策略与一个精确的全局解码器进行比较。该全局解码器利用混合整数线性规划联合选择得分最高的可行药物集合。在验证集和测试集上，全局解码始终比贪心修复、度感知修复以及结合穷举1-交换局部搜索强化的度感知修复获得更高的Jaccard相似度。其优势较小……
tldr: 该论文证明，在药物推荐中，基于混合整数线性规划的精确全局解码能够在满足药物相互作用约束的前提下，始终比各类局部修复策略选出得分更高的安全药物集合。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that exact global decoding via mixed-integer linear programming consistently selects higher-scoring feasible medication sets satisfying drug-drug interaction constraints than local repair strategies in medication recommendation.
